title: TDOA Position Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/TDOA_Position_Estimator.md
text: Estimate target position from time-difference of arrival, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Output covariances of TDOA position estimates} sets the output covariance of TDOA position and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: TDOAEst
ports.summary: Estimated time-difference of arrival (sec) ( L –1)-element real-valued vector

ports.name: TDOAVar
ports.summary: Estimated variances of time-differences of arrival (seconds-squared) ( L –1)-element real-valued vector

ports.name: AnchorPos
ports.summary: Anchor positions (meters) 2-by- L real-valued matrix | 3-by- L real-valued matrix

ports.name: TgtPosEst
ports.summary: Target position estimate real-valued Q -by-1 vector

ports.name: TgtPosCov
ports.summary: Target position covariance matrix real-valued positive semi-definite Q -by- Q matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst("LightSpeed") (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output covariances of TDOA position estimates
params.values: Output covariance of TDOA position estimates false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
